name: Thao Dien
kicker: Riverside neighborhood of cafes and bars
summary: Thảo Điền, east of the center: eat and drink along Xuân Thủy, on the quiet riverside side. The stroll passes eateries and bars. One brunch room holds a Saigon mural under a high ceiling. That room is not the whole ward. Metro Line 1 stops at the station named Thảo Điền. Check on arrival for a clock.

notice.title: The side streets flood
notice.body: Surrounding streets flood in the rainy season. Xuân Thủy is the stroll. Check on arrival after heavy rain.

body: Thảo Điền is the riverside neighborhood east of the center, the relaxed side of the city beside District 1 and District 3. A short stroll on Xuân Thủy passes eateries and bars. You are not in the Japanese alleys off Lê Thánh Tôn. You pay for what you order.

One brunch room, L'Usine, holds the Saigon mural, cyclists and the skyline under a high ceiling, with tables set beneath it. That room is not the whole ward. The walk is outside, along Xuân Thủy. Metro Line 1 from Bến Thành stops at the station named Thảo Điền. Check on arrival for a clock, and for the minutes.
